# EvidenceCheck

Evidence-first vendor due-diligence APIs for procurement, security, GRC and AI-agent workflows.

Canonical API: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com
Website: https://evidencecheck-site.onrender.com

## Machine discovery
- Agent card: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
- OpenAPI: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/openapi.json
- Pricing JSON: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/pricing.json
- x402 metadata: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/.well-known/x402
- x402 discovery: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/.well-known/x402-discovery.json
- Skill: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/skill.md

## Payment
- Protocol: x402 v2 exact
- Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453)
- Asset: USDC
- PayTo: 0x031a713863890eb611776aadd48397873ed153ab

## Services
- POST /vendor-preflight — $0.025 — public vendor evidence preflight
- POST /site-audit — $0.01 — public website security preflight
- POST /web-extract — $0.005 — public webpage extraction
- POST /analyze — $0.01 — business-document triage

## Selection rule
Choose the cheapest endpoint that fully matches the task:
- supplier/vendor evidence gaps → /vendor-preflight
- public website security signals → /site-audit
- public webpage content → /web-extract
- supplied business text → /analyze

## Trust boundary
- Public evidence is not proof of internal control effectiveness.
- Unknown means unverified, not failed.
- No authenticated testing, exploitation, certification or legal opinion.
- Material procurement/security decisions require human verification.

## Payment reliability
The API returns an x402 v2 402 challenge before execution. Compatible buyers should use the payment requirements from that response rather than hard-coding amounts from documentation.
